mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Le Clef Mot makes etymology accessible and engaging through the power of AI and visual storytelling. Every word has a rich history—a journey through time, cultures, and semantic transformations.

approach.title: Our Approach
approach.text: We combine deep linguistic analysis with cutting-edge AI to create immersive etymology experiences. Our dual-agent AI system—Cledor the etymologist and Cora the visual archivist—works in tandem.

cledor.name: Cledor: The Etymologist
cledor.description: Cledor traces word origins from modern French back to ancient roots, analyzing semantic shifts across historical eras.

cora.name: Cora: The Visual Archivist
cora.description: Cora transforms linguistic history into visual narratives, generating historically-accurate illustrations or retrieving museum artifacts.

team.title: The Team
team.text: Created by Allan Deschamps and Redbrush Agency, Le Clef Mot merges linguistic expertise with AI innovation.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.subtitle: How we unlock the soul of words
methodology.intro: Le Clef Mot uses a two-agent AI pipeline to transform simple word queries into immersive etymological experiences.

steps.title: Etymological Analysis
steps.description: Cledor receives the word and begins deep historical analysis.
details: Generates narrative chronology of word evolution
Creates visual prompt inspired by historical texts/scenes

steps.title: Visual Generation
steps.description: Cora takes Cledor's visual prompt and executes image generation.
details: Receives refined visual prompt from Cledor
On 402 error → fallback to RAG archive
Searches for relevant artifacts in museum archives
Returns image with metadata (source, tags, prompt)

steps.title: Final Assembly
steps.description: Cledor and Cora results are combined to create the final experience.

principles.title: Design Principles
items: Separation of concerns: Cledor = semantic, Cora = visual
Historical accuracy: contextualized prompts, authentic artifacts
Deep analysis: PIE roots, semantic shifts, cultural narratives
Visual excellence: neon aesthetics, smooth animations, premium typography
